data.name: AboutSubtitle
data.value: Premier simulation and analytical platform for Vietnamese banking stocks

data.name: AboutMissionDesc
data.value: BankStock is built to deliver a highly realistic, responsive, and visually modern stock market simulation tailored specifically for the banking sector - the cornerstone of Vietnam's financial market.

data.name: AboutFeature1Desc
data.value: Fintech dark theme styling following strict Vietnam stock conventions (Green, Red, Yellow, Purple, Cyan) with instantaneous response.

data.name: AboutFeature2Desc
data.value: Every new investor account receives an initial grant of 500,000,000 VND to test investment strategies safely without real monetary risks.

data.name: AboutFeature3Desc
data.value: Deep fundamental insights: CASA demand deposit ratio, NPL non-performing loan ratio, P/E, P/B, EPS, and quarterly financial reports.

data.name: AboutBanksDesc
data.value: Full coverage of Big 4 state-owned banks (VCB, BID, CTG) as well as leading private joint-stock commercial banks (TCB, MBB, VPB, ACB, STB, HDB, TPB).

data.name: AboutTechDesc
data.value: Engineered with .NET 8, ASP.NET Core MVC, Entity Framework Core 8, N-tier architecture, robust ASP.NET Identity with granular role authorization.
